basic_profile.bio: A 29-year-old living in Portland, Oregon, navigating the complexities of dietary restrictions due to fructose malabsorption and other digestive issues. Passionate about health and wellness, enjoys experimenting with gluten-free vegan recipes. Works as a graphic designer, often logging into Reddit during lunch breaks or late at night. Recently single, interested in connecting with others who have similar dietary challenges and lifestyle interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Has a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and a growing interest in nutrition and digestive health. Self-taught in dietary adjustments due to personal health needs. Relies on online forums and medical articles for information.
